title: geum × intermedium willdenowii
intro: Geum × intermedium willdenowii, commonly known as the Willdenow's Avens, is a hybrid plant species belonging to the Rosaceae family. This perennial herb is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help in soothing digestive issues and reducing oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Geum × intermedium willdenowii include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce fever, and act as an anti-diarrheal agent. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
